author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Zach Neto hit a three-run homer over the Green Monster as the Los Angeles Angels beat the Boston Red Sox 6-4 Wednesday night at Fenway Park to win the three-game series.

Jose Siri added a two-run homer and Denzer Guzman hit a solo shot for Los Angeles, which won consecutive games for the first time since mid-August. The Angels built a 6-0 lead and secured their first road-series victory since taking two of three from Houston in August.

Boston’s comeback included a two-run homer by Roman Anthony and a solo homer from Wilyer Abreu. Starter Jake Bennett allowed a season-high six runs, including five in one inning, on nine hits over 5 1/3 innings. Ben Joyce recorded the final three outs for his fourth save despite allowing a run.

The Red Sox won Monday’s opener but dropped the final two games. Boston still took the season series 4-2. The club begins a three-game home series Friday against Kansas City, with right-hander Sonny Gray scheduled to start.
dek: Zach Neto’s three-run homer helped Los Angeles win 6-4 at Fenway Park and take two of three from Boston.
headline: Angels beat Red Sox 6-4 to claim series at Fenway
